I know it’s way more than most people would eat at once, but in the moment I just keep going.

I eat until my stomach hurts, like I can barely move, but I still don’t stop until it’s all gone. I usually do it in my truck in a parking lot, or late at night in the kitchen after my wife’s gone to bed. I’m embarrassed by how out of control it feels, so I hide it from her and the guys at the station. D023_m001.options:

    D. Binge-Eating Disorder
